title: New routes for image generation and editing
summary:
Image and text models changed routes, Enter got more usable on phones, and an image-enhancement experiment was reverted the same day.

`kontext` moved to Azure Flux Kontext for generation and image editing, with a 1024-pixel maximum side length. Nano Banana was added as a nectar-tier image model. GPT Image now uses `gpt-image-1-mini` for generation and `gpt-image-1` for edits with input images.

`deepseek` now uses DeepSeek V3.1 with hybrid reasoning; the former reasoning model names remain as aliases. `mistral` moved from Small 3.1 to 3.2, and `mistral-naughty` replaced the `mistral-romance` listing while keeping the old name as an alias. A text-service startup fix addressed its TypeScript model imports.

Enter’s sign-in, account and Balance layouts were adjusted for mobile. API key lists remain scrollable on narrow screens. The Pollen FAQ now explains model usage in images per Pollen and clarifies that one wallet works across apps.

highlights.title: Kontext for image editing
highlights.text: Use `kontext` for text-to-image generation or edits based on an input image. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).

highlights.title: Nano Banana added
highlights.text: Generate images with `nanobanana`, the Gemini 2.5 Flash Image Preview model, at nectar tier. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).

highlights.title: DeepSeek V3.1 with reasoning
highlights.text: `deepseek` now uses DeepSeek V3.1 with hybrid reasoning. Existing `deepseek-reasoning` and `deepseek-r1-0528` names remain aliases. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek).

highlights.title: Mistral Small 3.2
highlights.text: `mistral` now uses Mistral Small 3.2. The previous 3.1 aliases still work. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
